what: 44 rows of the test of src/ias/reg.js against a 40 digit multiple precision flow: a pair with periapsis distance q (1e-4, 3e-4, 1e-3) perturbed by the third body at the distance R from the pair, equal masses, two phases (phase) and two lengths (k, in periods), ratio R/measured from 50 to 3333. start (12 numbers) and tau: the start state and the length of the piece; ref_end: the reference end state (40 digits, strings); error: largest difference of the end state of reg.js from it; limit: the limit of the row; r = error / limit; zone: PASS if r < 1. ratio = R / measured, the guard ratio d2/d1 of the row at the pericentre (measured = smallest pair distance). R_lowest(q): the smallest ratio of the rows of that q (all rows pass). K_final = 1.5 x the largest R_lowest(q) = 1.5 x 257.2 = 385.9, rounded up to a multiple of 10: 390. No row fails, so the test does not give a ratio below which reg.js stops passing; 390 is a value derived from this grid, not a bound.
